general.title: Next scheduled council election
general.status: Scheduled by the four-year, last-Saturday-in-March rule; subject to change by regulation and the official election timetable.
general.dateBasis: Calendar calculation from the rule published by ECQ, not an issued notice of election. The countdown reaches the start of the scheduled day in Queensland, not the opening of polling booths.

earlyVoting.status: No Redland 2028 early-voting timetable verified in this first pass. Dates, eligibility, opening hours and locations will be linked when ECQ publishes the election details.

byElection.status: Possible scenario only. No Redland mayoral by-election was listed in the ECQ election-events page checked on 16 October 2026. Leave discussions do not supply an official election date.

refreshTriggers: Official vacancy notice or ECQ election notice
ECQ early-voting or postal-voting timetable published or changed
New candidate acceptance, withdrawal or declaration
Election day reached; verify status and results
